voices.note: The channel narrator of both finished videos; the creator's own word, 'the voice is good' (Blueprint veto line V1): only his recorded word replaces it (VC-08). Baseline = the median timbre of Episode 1's Day 1 read before it drifted (spectral tilt -21.3 dB, centroid about 1250 Hz; voice_check docstring, 2026-10-16), not a library preview: the free preview measured centroid 914 Hz and tilt -21.8 dB (sha256 e09253de529f8b2a817af2e55c54979e1109954c89289c120b743f370012a8d5), a stylised sample 27 % darker in centroid, so a preview is never a baseline for centroid. Replace the baseline with the approved first piece of the next episode's sample (OR-19) with `python -m explainer_engine.audio.voice_audition baseline <read> --kind read --ref <path>`.
